::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 26 [1864]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: MS English Letters: e 86.
:::

My dear [Mr Moor](people/person_1046.qmd)
I think it will be much better to throw the prizes open to the whole schools [sic]; it is so discouraging and troublesome to be put out of the competition, and everyone has not a garden who has children at school

My [mother](people/person_1606.qmd) says she meant her prizes instead of the home prize - of course they would chiefly concern the <u>first</u> - not the second - if all the extraparochial people are necessarily in the 3d class, she would extend it to them.

I suppose it will not wait till we see you

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper. Envelope addressed to “The Revd/ J F Moor/Ampfield/Romsey. Postmarked Winchester J 24/64.
